cases.name: Eleanor Sophia Grosshans Lynch
cases.about: She was a night clerk at the Dixie Motel on Route 1 in Woodbridge Township, NJ. Her mother described her as quiet and shy and having had a lot of heartbreak in life. She was considered a very conscientious employee.
cases.narrative:
On 1/14/1964 her body was found in the incinerator room of the Cromwell Terrace Apartments at 372 Mt Prospect Ave. in Newark, NJ. She had been raped and strangled to death and had 62 post-mortem stab wounds in her back and sides by 2-and-a-half-inch pocket-knife blade. A man's shirt and necktie were knotted around her throat. Her hands were tied separately spread-eagle with two neckties to steam pipes above her with her dress and sweater raised around her neck. She was wearing a bra. Her underwear, shoes and stockings were scattered on the floor. The doctor who did the autopsy said the ties were not tight enough to strangle her.

She had been abducted from the motel where she worked. Her purse was found inside her car which was still parked at the motel where she worked as a night clerk at the Dixie Motel on Route 1 in Woodbridge Township, NJ.
